definitions.gloss: difference in build; difference in physique; size gap
definitions.explanation: The difference in body size, build, or physical stature between two or more people. Frequently discussed in sports, martial arts, and physical confrontations where body size plays a decisive role.

examples.japanese: {体格差|たいかくさ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{生|い}かして⟦{勝|か}った→勝つ：01199_katsu⟧。
examples.english: He won by taking advantage of the size difference.

examples.japanese: {体格差|たいかくさ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あって→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{補|おぎな}える→補う：00329_oginau⟧。
examples.english: Even with a size gap, you can make up for it with skill.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{体格差|たいかくさ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{相手|あいて}→相手：01677_aite⟧⟦に{対|たい}して→に対して：06800_nitaishite⟧、⟦スピード→スピード：11048_supiido⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{連携|れんけい}→連携：05094_renkei⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{対抗|たいこう}した→対抗する：17344_taikousuru⟧。
examples.english: The Japanese team countered the physically larger opponents with speed and teamwork.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{体格|たいかく}→体格：16207_taikaku⟧ (physique, build) and ⟦{差|さ}→差：02771_sa⟧ (difference). A common term in sports commentary, especially when discussing matchups between athletes or teams of different physical statures.

In Japanese sports culture, {体格差|たいかくさ} is a frequent topic because Japanese athletes are often smaller than their international competitors, making discussions of how to overcome this gap a recurring theme.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {体格差|たいかくさ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: there is a size difference
- {体格差|たいかくさ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{生|い}かす: to exploit a size advantage
- {体格差|たいかくさ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{埋|う}める→埋める：01901_umeru⟧: to bridge the size gap
- {体格差|たいかくさ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{補|おぎな}う→補う：00329_oginau⟧: to compensate for the size gap
- ⟦{圧倒的|あっとうてき}→圧倒的：05853_attouteki⟧な{体格差|たいかくさ}: an overwhelming size difference

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {身長差|しんちょうさ}: height difference — specifically about height
- {体重差|たいじゅうさ}: weight difference — specifically about weight
- {体力差|たいりょくさ}: difference in stamina/physical strength
